figurative_meaning_en: A woman without husband and children; barren
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামে সবাই তাকে দাণ্ডা-খাণ্ডা বলে উপহাস করে।
তার বিয়ে হয়েছে কিন্তু সে দাণ্ডা-খাণ্ডা হয়ে রয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: In the village, everyone mocks her as a barren woman without children.
She got married but remains childless and widowed.
note: This idiom reflects patriarchal views on women's fertility in traditional Bengali society.
